messages:
alex: FYI deploybot auto-pinned runtime 4.6 for model:fast-embed after a latency spike on long tail. anyone on call?

deploybot: auto-pin: runtime 4.6 -> 4.5 selector=model:fast-embed reason="p95 latency > 800ms" expires=2026-04-26T02:00Z

maya: Seeing p95 regressions on requests with batch_size>8. stack traces point to new batching kernel in 4.6.

sasha: Can we do a targeted pin for selector api:embed-small only (avoid full rollback)?

ops-lead: Yes, run `deploybot pin runtime 4.5 --selector=api:embed-small --reason="batching regress" --expires=2026-04-26T02:00Z` and open a hotfix ticket.

alex: Hotfix owner @eng-runtime? Maya will take it. Plan: disable aggressive batch coalescing in 4.6 and run 2h canary.

maya: Branch created: fix/batch-coalesce-fallback. CI passing locally. Starting canary in 10m.

deploybot: pin applied for api:embed-small by ops-lead. telemetry link: https://obsv/internal/1805000000

release-czar: Approved targeted pin. If canary passes, we unpin during Wed daytime window. Publish short incident note if >10 customers affected.

sasha: Will run smoke tests after canary and report errors/latency here.
